tooltip.tieredarcana.wand.use: Right-click to cast your active spell. Sneak + scroll to switch spells.
tooltip.tieredarcana.spellbook: Right-click (or press B) to choose your active spell. Must be in your inventory to cast.
tooltip.tieredarcana.scroll.learn: Learn it at a Tier %s+ shrine: place it on the Arcane Pedestal, then activate the Void Crystal Core.
tooltip.tieredarcana.mana_crystal.cap: Each shrine tier you attune to allows more crystals
tooltip.tieredarcana.mana_gem.use: Right-click to draw mana. Recharge it on an active shrine's pedestal.
message.tieredarcana.need_book: Your spellbook must be in your inventory to cast.
message.tieredarcana.no_spell: No spell selected – open your spellbook.
message.tieredarcana.wand_too_weak: This wand can't channel Tier %s spells.
message.tieredarcana.crystal_attune: Attune to an active shrine before using a Mana Crystal.
message.tieredarcana.crystal_cap: Your body can hold no more crystals (%s). Upgrade your shrine to absorb more.
message.tieredarcana.attuned: You are now attuned to a Tier %s shrine.
message.tieredarcana.shrine_incomplete: The shrine is incomplete – %s blocks missing. Hold a wand near the crystal to see where they go.
message.tieredarcana.tier_built: Tier %s is built! Place %s on the pedestal and activate the crystal to awaken it.
message.tieredarcana.next_tier_missing: Tier %s needs %s more blocks. Hold a wand near the crystal to see where.
message.tieredarcana.need_catalysts: The ritual for %s needs these catalysts on the Catalyst Crystals:
message.tieredarcana.shrine_status: Shrine Tier %s is active. Place a spell scroll on the pedestal and activate the crystal to begin a ritual.
message.tieredarcana.shrine_max: This is the highest shrine tier available in this version.
message.tieredarcana.gem_charging: The Mana Gem is charging (%s stored).
message.tieredarcana.ritual_start: The ritual for %s begins – stay close to the shrine...
message.tieredarcana.ritual_running: A ritual is already in progress.
message.tieredarcana.ritual_away: The ritual fizzled – you strayed too far from the shrine.
message.tieredarcana.learned: You learned %s! It's now written in your spellbook.
screen.tieredarcana.status.active: ★ Active – your wand casts this spell
screen.tieredarcana.status.known: Learned – click to make it your active spell
screen.tieredarcana.status.unknown: Not learned – place its scroll on a Tier %s shrine
screen.tieredarcana.hint: Pick a school tab, then click a learned spell to make it active. Press V (or sneak + scroll with a wand) to cycle spells.
spell.tieredarcana.magic_missile.desc: Fires a bolt of arcane force that flies dead straight.
spell.tieredarcana.light_orb.desc: Conjures a floating orb of light where you are looking. Break it by hand.
spell.tieredarcana.fireball.desc: Hurls a blazing fireball that sets its target alight.
spell.tieredarcana.frost_nova.desc: A ring of frost bursts from you, damaging, slowing and freezing nearby creatures.
spell.tieredarcana.blink.desc: Step through the Void, teleporting up to 8 blocks the way you are facing.
spell.tieredarcana.growth.desc: Floods an area with life, growing crops and plants like bone meal.
spell.tieredarcana.lightning_strike.desc: Calls a bolt of lightning down where you are looking.
spell.tieredarcana.void_shield.desc: Wraps you in Void energy that absorbs damage and hardens your skin.
spell.tieredarcana.levitate.desc: Lifts you into the air, then lets you drift slowly back down.
spell.tieredarcana.meteor.desc: Pulls a burning meteor down from the sky onto your target.
spell.tieredarcana.void_rift.desc: Tears open a rift that drags in and crushes every creature nearby.
